title: Grid Model: An Entropic and Dynamic Theory for Emergent Gravity in Cosmology
abstract: Proposes an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) Grid Model in which gravity emerges from entropy-regulated energy flow rather than from dark matter or a cosmological constant. The paper links entropy, energy-flow gradients, and a dynamic effective gravity to observed rotation curves, gravitational lensing trends, high-ℓ CMB anisotropy deviations, and environment-dependent gravitational-wave propagation, supported by simulations and comparisons to JWST, SDSS/eFEDS, Planck, HST, and LIGO data.
